column1: # p215 - ACTION QD: the 94 rows this KB recorded as ABSENT, re-read through the `git ls-tree` channel
# method: git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --depth 1  ->  git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only
#         (complete file inventory, ZERO blob transfer), then read only the candidate blobs over
#         raw.githubusercontent.com and classify from the TITLE WINDOW (P214-1: a whole-body matcher
#         reads GPL-3.0 as AGPL-3.0 because GPL-3.0 section 13 is titled "Use with the GNU Affero GPL")
# bytes: binary-safe (curl -o file; wc -c). A text-mode pipe strips CR and understates a CRLF blob
#        by one byte per line - see P215-5 and the eol column.
